registration_scope: after development feature exploration, before calibration fitting and any test prediction/scoring
brier_definition: mean(sum over classes squared probability errors), range 0 to 2

calibration.optimizer: bounded scalar minimization in inverse temperature; compare with identity and endpoints

reference_reason: lowest raw development validation Log Loss among fitted estimators; selection is a development decision, not test evidence
secondary_feature_comparisons: same six contrasts with raw probabilities

paired_bootstrap.intervals: marginal 95% and Bonferroni-style percentile 99.1667% for six temperature contrasts; bootstrap coverage approximate

test_prediction_policy: sequential snapshots using strictly previous local dates; no estimator or calibrator refit in test
player_state: season reset, same P/F formulas as development
test_cohort: same 380 matches for all registered arms, no performance-based exclusions
final_model_selection: report all registered results; do not choose raw vs calibrated or tune models using test
availability_claim: retrospective reconstruction; next-local-midnight assumption, source publication time not verified
